rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: You are behind the white house, where a path enters the forest to the east.  In one corner of the house there is a small window which is slightly ajar.
rooms.title: Behind House

rooms.description: You are about 10 feet above the ground nestled among some large branches. The nearest branch above you is above your reach. A bird's nest is tangled around a branch here. In the nest is a large egg encrusted with precious jewels and inlaid with  gold, apparently scavenged somewhere by a childless songbird.
rooms.title: Up a Tree

rooms.description: This is a small beach on the Frigid River below the Falls. A rainbow  crosses over the falls to the east and a path leads to the southwest.
rooms.title: End of Rainbow

rooms.description: This room is full of discarded bags, which crumble at your touch. There  is an exit down a staircase.
rooms.title: Thief's Den

rooms.description: This is a non-descript part of a coal mine.
rooms.title: Coal Mine

rooms.description: You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door. There is a mailbox here.
rooms.title: West of House

rooms.description: The river is running faster here, and the roar of rushing water is almost  unbearable. You can see beaches on both the east and west shores.
rooms.title: Frigid River

rooms.description: This is a tiny cave with an entrance on the north, and a  forbidding staircase leading down.
rooms.title: Windy Cave

rooms.description: You are on a large sandy beach on the east shore of the river. A path runs  along the river to the south, and a cave that is partially buried in sand  lies to the northeast.
rooms.title: Sandy Beach

rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike. A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: This is a non-descript part of a coal mine. The top of a  rickety ladder pokes through a hole in the floor.
rooms.title: Coal Mine

rooms.description: This is a drafty room at the bottom of a long shaft. To the south is a  passageway and to the east a very narrow crack. In the shaft can be seen  a heavy iron chain.
rooms.title: Drafty Room

rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: You are atop the west wall of a great canyon. From here there is a superb view of the Frigid River as it flows out of a dark cavern, flanked by towering white cliffs. Below rainbow-clad Aragain Falls, the river twists  into a passage which is impossible to enter. Paths enter the forest to the west and north. It is possible to climb down into the canyon from here.
rooms.title: Canyon View

rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: This is a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a coal mine. There are openings to the north and east, and a steep metal slide twisting  downward.
rooms.title: Slide Room

rooms.description: This is a non-descript part of a coal mine.
rooms.title: Coal Mine

rooms.description: You have come to a dead end in the maze.
rooms.title: Dead End

rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: This is a large room with exits to the west and north. In the middle of  the room is a small shaft descending through the floor into darkness below. Constructed over the top of the shaft is a metal framework to which a heavy  iron chain is attached. A foul odor comes from the room to the north.
rooms.title: Shaft Room

rooms.description: This is a path winding through a dimly-lit forest. The path turns a corner  here, heading south and east. One large tree with some low branches stands  at the edge of the path.
rooms.title: Forest Path

rooms.description: This is a sand-filled cave whose exit is to the southwest.
rooms.title: Sandy Cave

rooms.description: This appears to have been an artist's studio. The walls and floors are  splattered with paint. At the west end of the room is an open door. A  narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although you might be able to  get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back down.
rooms.title: Studio

rooms.description: This is a long east-west passage which is cluttered with broken timbers.  At the east end of the room, a rickety ladder leads through an opening in  the roof. A strong draft comes from the west where the room narrows  considerably.
rooms.title: Timber Room

rooms.description: You are on a quiet section of the Frigid River near the Dam. There is  a landing on the west shore.
rooms.title: Frigid River

rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: This is a small room with passages to the east and south and a forbidding hole leading west. Bloodstains and deep scratches mar the walls.
rooms.title: The Troll Room

rooms.description: You are at the entrance of a disused coal mine. Strange squeaky sounds  come from a shaft leading into the north wall, and there is another exit  to the south.
rooms.title: Mine Entrance

rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: You are south of the white house. There is no door here, and all the  windows are boarded.
rooms.title: South of House

rooms.description: This is a circular stone room with passages in all directions, although  several have been blocked by cave-ins.
rooms.title: Round Room

rooms.description: This was maintenance room for Flood Control Dam #3. On the wall is an  important-looking button. The west wall contains a door.
rooms.title: Maintenance Room

rooms.description: You are at the base of a river canyon near the flowing runoff of Aragain  Falls. The cliff wall may be climbable, and to the northeast is a narrow path.
rooms.title: Canyon Bottom

rooms.description: You are east of a massive stone tomb. Through an open door you see  darkness within.
rooms.title: Stone Barrow

rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: You have come to a dead end in the maze.
rooms.title: Dead End

rooms.description: This is the attic. The only exit is a stairway leading down.
rooms.title: Attic

rooms.description: This is a former Egyptian tomb. There is an ascending staircase to the west.
rooms.title: Egyptian Room

rooms.description: You are next to the altar at the south end of the temple. In one corner is a small hole in the floor.
rooms.title: Altar

rooms.description: You are on a path in a dimly-lit forest. The path heads west  into the heart of the forest, and to the southeast where the trees seem to  thin out.
rooms.title: Forest Edge

rooms.description: You are at the base of the dam, on a bank of the river Frigid.
rooms.title: Dam Base

rooms.description: This is the north end of a large temple. Engraved on the east wall is  a prayer in a long-forgotten language. Below the prayer is a staircase  leading down.
rooms.title: Temple

rooms.description: You have entered the Land of the Living Dead. You can hear the sounds of thousands of lost souls weeping and moaning. A passage exits to the north.
rooms.title: Land of the Dead

rooms.description: The river descends into a valley with a narrow beach on the west shore.  In the distance a rumbling can be heard.
rooms.title: Frigid River

rooms.description: This room smells strongly of coal gas. Tunnels lead south and east.
rooms.title: Gas Room

rooms.description: You are on a narrow beach at the base of the White Cliffs. A passage  leads west into the Cliffs.
rooms.title: White Cliffs Beach

rooms.description: This is a small cave with exits on the east and west.
rooms.title: Dusty Cave

rooms.description: You are north of the white house. There is no door here, and all the  windows are boarded up. To the north a narrow path enters the woods.
rooms.title: North of House

rooms.description: You are on what used to be a large lake, but which is now a large mud pile. There are 'shores' to the north and south.
rooms.title: Reservoir

rooms.description: You have come to a dead end in the mine.
rooms.title: Dead End
